column1: # Accepted findings on corpus-constructs/. The fixtures carry no seeded defects, so a row here is
# either a true finding on a fixture written to carry the construct the rule reads — RESTART= on a
# JOB card, a step that allocates none of its program's DDs — or a false positive judged not worth
# changing the rule for. "*" in place of file:line accepts every finding of that rule.
# RuleEvaluationReportTest fails on a finding missing from this file and on a row that no longer
# A reason that opens "rule limit:" marks a finding the rule should not have made: the fixture is
# valid code with no construction reason behind the hit, so the row is a candidate rule fix. Every
# other reason says for itself which of the two kinds its row is.
